summary: Seal one precommit actor transport allocation transaction with AllocationError/allocate responsibility and zero postcommit allocation; product checker/MIR/runtime NOT_RUN.
requires: the selected ActorTransport CallPlan preserves throws AllocationError and effects allocate independently from its value Result
receiver closure precedes bounded capacity rejection and both precede allocation
envelope, required mailbox storage and request-only responsibility storage are all prepared before enqueue commit
allocation failure retains sender ownership, reverse-cleans staged resources and publishes no message, sequence, ReplyId or CorrelationId
enqueue commit publishes the prepared transaction once and postcommit allocation count is zero
preconditions: one ActorTransport target and call shape are already selected
operand values remain sender-owned until commit
normalization: separate ActorMessageError Result values from the exact AllocationError/allocate dynamic responsibility and one precommit allocation plan
decision_procedure: reject a CallPlan that omits AllocationError or allocate
return receiverClosedBeforeAdmission if the locked receiver is closed
for bounded_reject_v1 return mailboxFull if capacity is full
otherwise stage all required resources and propagate AllocationError on any failure with zero publication
commit message, sequence, moved owners and request identities atomically; reject verified MIR containing a required postcommit allocation
termination_metric: one finite CallPlan and three ordered allocation stages
evaluation_order: static selection -> operands once -> locked receiver/capacity checks -> all allocations -> one enqueue commit
